name: AR Puppis

images.credit: Kluska et al. 2019, Fig. 5 (crop: ZIMPOL V panel)

paper.title: Resolved imaging of the AR Puppis circumbinary disk

notes: RV Tauri post-AGB circumbinary disk resolved with VLT/SPHERE ZIMPOL (V,I) and IRDIS (H); Kluska et al. 2019 (arXiv:1901.04109). Distance poorly constrained (~1-6 kpc per van Leeuwen 2007 / Gaia DR2, hence dist_pc left null); comparable systems (IRAS 08544-4431, L2 Pup) suggest ~350-500 pc may be more likely but is not adopted here without a firmer measurement.
